scope_notes: This is an installed Python distribution metadata snapshot, not a lockfile or a complete native/JavaScript/model SBOM.

Direct means an active root requirements.txt entry. Transitive means reachable through Requires-Dist with markers evaluated for this environment and no optional extras. Remaining installed distributions are environment tooling or extras.
Raw license fields and classifiers are preserved. SPDX is normalized only when packaging.licenses accepts a declared field; null means not established, not no license.
License file paths refer to the installed distribution and are not copies included in the source repository.
Python dependency binaries, Python runtime, OCR weights and local system fonts are not bundled in this source submission. Installing dependencies may install binary libraries and OCR weights.
